title: Off-site accessory parking spaces in public garages
previewText: Section 36-56 (Accessory Off-street Parking Spaces in Public Garages) shall be modified to allow accessory off-street parking spaces in any public parking garage developed after December 10, 2012, provided such off-site spaces comply with the provisions of Section 101-55 (Location of Off-site Parking Spaces).
